description: Review Focus 2, spec §5.5: IsNearPlayerView(loc, 8000) is true 20 m and false 100 m from the player's camera. Two SEDANs at 80 km/h on the open ground west of the start line, heading away from the parked player's camera, drift for 1 s (full lock with the handbrake): the one that starts 20 m from the camera leaves BP_DFFxPuff tyre smoke around it; the one that starts 100 m away (drifting at 0.5 s, and still beyond 80 m at the end) leaves none. SEDAN on the drive strip in the gear the auto-box holds at its start speed, raw AI controller (unsmoothed, unscaled inputs), the car ticking after the test, physics in step with game time (time dilation 0.25).
